findings.title: High CPU utilization detected (96.86% busy)
likely_causes: Compute-bound worker loops or serialization overhead
findings.recommendation: Inspect top CPU-consuming PIDs with scripts/collect_process_metrics.py and check cgroup throttling.

findings.title: Elevated I/O wait (17.59%) or blocked tasks (4)
likely_causes: Synchronous disk writes (fsync/fdatasync) saturating backing storage
Memory pressure causing major page faults and swap I/O
findings.recommendation: Run scripts/inspect_io.sh to inspect per-device await/utilization and identify uninterruptible sleep (D-state) processes.

findings.title: High system memory utilization (95.0% used)
likely_causes: Unbounded application heap or cache growth
Insufficient container or VM memory allocation relative to worker concurrency
findings.recommendation: Check process RSS growth using scripts/collect_process_metrics.py and verify cgroup memory.max limits.

findings.title: Kernel OOM killer invocations recorded (oom_kill=3)
likely_causes: Host or cgroup memory exhaustion triggering Linux OOM killer
findings.recommendation: Inspect cgroup memory.events for oom_kill counters and set bounded heap limits on worker processes.

findings.title: Container CFS CPU throttling detected (35.0% of periods throttled)
likely_causes: Multi-threaded application bursting above container CPU quota within 100ms period
Restrictive Kubernetes/Docker CPU limit relative to worker thread count
findings.recommendation: Increase container CPU limit or tune runtime worker threads (e.g., GOMAXPROCS, UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE) to match effective CPU quota.

findings.title: Cgroup OOM events recorded (oom_kill=2, oom=4)
likely_causes: Container memory working set exceeded cgroup memory limit
findings.recommendation: Increase container memory limit or configure runtime heap bounds (e.g., NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size, GOMEMLIMIT) below cgroup memory ceiling.

findings.title: Elevated per-cgroup Pressure Stall Information (memory full avg10=11.8%, io full avg10=31.4%)
likely_causes: Cgroup tasks stalled on direct memory reclaim or cgroup I/O throttling
findings.recommendation: Inspect cgroup memory.high/memory.max and io.max limits.

findings.title: High CLOSE_WAIT socket accumulation (65 sockets)
likely_causes: Application failing to call close() on sockets after remote peer FIN disconnect
Worker thread starvation preventing socket cleanup
findings.recommendation: Audit application connection pool lifecycle and ensure HTTP/DB client connections are closed in finally/defer blocks.

findings.title: Elevated TCP segment retransmission rate (2.3%: 18400/800000 segments)
likely_causes: Network congestion, NIC ring buffer drops, or cloud virtual switch bandwidth policing
findings.recommendation: Check interface tx_drop/rx_drop counters and TCP congestion control settings.

findings.title: UDP socket receive buffer drops recorded (RcvbufErrors=24)
likely_causes: net.core.rmem_max too small for burst UDP traffic (e.g., DNS/QUIC/StatsD)
findings.recommendation: Increase net.core.rmem_max or scale UDP reader threads.

findings.title: TCP listen queue overflows detected (ListenOverflows=340, ListenDrops=340)
likely_causes: Application accept() loop is stalled or net.core.somaxconn / net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog is undersized
findings.recommendation: Raise net.core.somaxconn and application listen() backlog parameter, and check worker CPU throttling.

findings.title: Detected 65 sockets with elevated Recv-Q or Send-Q buffers
likely_causes: Slow application reader (high Recv-Q) or congested downstream receiver (high Send-Q)
findings.recommendation: Inspect stalled reader/writer processes holding queued sockets.

findings.title: Network interface packet drops or errors detected (total=547)
likely_causes: Ring buffer exhaustion, NIC IRQ saturation, or virtual bridge policing
findings.recommendation: Inspect per-interface rx_drop/tx_drop counts and verify ring buffer sizing.

findings.title: Process 4242 (order-worker) is in uninterruptible sleep (D state)
likely_causes: Blocked on synchronous disk I/O, NFS mount stall, or kernel mutex contention
findings.recommendation: Inspect block device latency with scripts/inspect_io.sh and check /proc/<pid>/sched iowait_sum.

findings.title: Process 4242 (order-worker) exhibits CPU run-queue contention or involuntary preemption
likely_causes: Thread count exceeds available CPU cores or cgroup CFS quota is throttling runnable threads
findings.recommendation: Compare process thread count against cgroup CPU quota using scripts/inspect_cgroups.py.

findings.title: Process 4242 experiencing swap usage or major page faults
likely_causes: Working set exceeds available physical or cgroup memory
findings.recommendation: Tune process memory footprint or increase container memory.max allocation.

findings.title: Container CFS quota throttling is actively restricting application threads
likely_causes: Container CPU quota (cpu.max / cfs_quota_us) is exhausted within 100ms scheduling periods
findings.recommendation: Raise container CPU limit or right-size worker thread pool count to match container effective CPUs.

recommendations: Identify top CPU threads via collect_process_metrics.py and verify whether CPU time is user-space or kernel-space.
Execute scripts/inspect_io.sh to correlate iowait with specific block devices.
Audit high-RSS processes and check cgroup memory events for OOM risk.
Correlate /proc/vmstat oom_kill with container cgroup memory.events.
Align application thread pool size with effective cgroup CPU quota or raise CPU limits.
Set language runtime memory limits to 80-85% of container memory limit to prevent kernel OOM kills.
Investigate cgroup-level PSI stalls in memory.pressure and io.pressure.
Fix application socket leak indicated by elevated CLOSE_WAIT connections.
Investigate network path packet loss driving TCP retransmissions.
Remediate TCP accept queue saturation indicated by TcpExt.ListenOverflows.
Check backing storage latency for D-state process.
Right-size application worker threads to reduce run-queue wait time and involuntary context switches.
